title: “Lord, help me trust Your presence even when the waves feel close.”
paragraphs: “Lord, help me trust Your presence even when the waves feel close.”

When I read the Bible, it often feels like I’m there—standing nearby, watching quietly.
The wind howls. The water rages. Fear fills the boat.
Then His voice speaks—and the storm listens.

I am not part of the story.
I am simply a witness.
Yet my heart recognizes this moment.

What storms still feel louder than His peace?
What would it mean to trust His calm—before the waters settle?

🌿 Stillness → awe → peace → gentle curiosity
🌤️ Quiet reflection | Evening tone | Comfort & courage
